chapter: Boston, Buffalo and finding a style
title: Leaving Buffalo with the humming-and-bowing style formed
summary: On leaving Buffalo he was already humming and bowing, and again credits Ray Perry as his inspiration.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Yeah. When you say you left the band to venture out further and get closer to home, did you move to New York?
Yes. Yeah. I -- when I left Buffalo, by that time I was humming and bowing the bass pretty good, you know. But did I ever tell you about the fellow whom I got, inspired me to hum and --
Oh, yeah, you told me about it.
Right. Now, so you had begun -- so you
started getting that style together by then.
